newsitem.title: JAPAN: Funds likely to remain in Japan OTC shares--report.
newsitem.headline: Funds likely to remain in Japan OTC shares--report.

text.p: UBS Securities Ltd said on Monday that money was likely to flow back into the second section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the over-the-counter (OTC) market, as small-stock funds sell off the 26 second-section issues which shifted to the first section on September 2.
UBS said the funds, most of which are limited to issues in the second section and the OTC market, will sell their investments in the 26 issues and reinvest the money in the two markets.
The buying, while gradual, will be a positive factor for the two markets, UBS said.
The market value of the 26 issues is about 5.1 trillion yen, UBS said.

Among the 26, Acom Co Ltd and Promise Co Ltd are highly likely to be sold off by the funds, which normally invest in companies which have fewer shares and a smaller market value than average on the first section.
